guardrails.name: Zero Polling Overhead
guardrails.description: Never introduce setInterval() or polling loops in extension/content.js or ytm-*.js. State extraction must be strictly reactive via HTML5 <video> events and scoped MutationObserver callbacks.

guardrails.name: Context Isolation Boundary
guardrails.description: MAIN World scripts (content.js, ytm-*.js) have zero access to chrome.* APIs. ISOLATED World (bridge.js) has zero access to YouTube DOM or #movie_player. Communication is strictly bidirectional via window.postMessage.

guardrails.name: BFCache & Lifecycle Teardown
guardrails.description: Ensure full MutationObserver and EventListener teardown on tab unload (beforeunload/pagehide) and clean BFCache freeze/resume handling to prevent memory leaks in long sessions.

guardrails.name: WebSocket Hygiene & Loop Prevention
guardrails.description: Guard WebSocket reconnection loops with isTabClosing flag on tab unload. Provide prompt heartbeat ping/pong responses.

guardrails.name: Scrubbing DOM Query Avoidance
guardrails.description: Avoid repetitive DOM queries during scrubbing and high-frequency timeupdate events. Utilize negative caching and dirty-checking before message dispatches.

guardrails.name: Hardware Refresh Limit (10 Hz)
guardrails.description: Programmatic updates to Stream Deck keys, canvas drawings, and LCD touchstrips must never exceed 10 updates per second (10 Hz).

guardrails.name: Dial Rotary Streaming & Debounce
guardrails.description: Enforce DialRotaryStreamer with 100-ms throttle and 110-ms settle debounce across all rotary dials to prevent hardware message queue saturation.

guardrails.name: Stream Deck IPC Deduplication
guardrails.description: Deduplicate setFeedback calls to avoid identical UI payloads and prevent redundant setState invocations when state is unchanged.

guardrails.name: Timer Lifecycle Hygiene
guardrails.description: Ensure no running setInterval or setTimeout timers persist on inactive profiles or dials (strict willDisappear lifecycle cleanup).

guardrails.name: In-Memory Asset Pipeline & Bounded Caching
guardrails.description: Album cover art, thumbnails, and dynamic canvas drawings must remain strictly in RAM as Base64 Data URLs. Use FNV-1a hashing and LRU cache eviction in ImageRenderer to prevent unbounded memory growth.

guardrails.name: Strict Typing Discipline
guardrails.description: Prohibited in TypeScript: 'as any', '@ts-ignore', '@ts-expect-error'. All types and settings must be defined or extended in plugin/src/types/.

guardrails.name: Clean Production Logging
guardrails.description: No orphaned console.log() or console.debug() statements in plugin production code. Use the dedicated project logger.
